move.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We appreciate your interest in putting your available machine capacity to work with us, and understand that our late invoice payments have caused concern. Our volume is fixed and represents our full demand for this part over the term, all with you. Could you review your offer in light of that commitment and current material costs?

Another bidder offers EUR 31.50 per unit for this part (offer:70240-0).
Electricity producer prices changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Your on-time delivery was 80.8% in 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 27.86 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
